title: ClawBench: Real-World Benchmark for Live Web Agents
summary: An evaluation suite that tests AI agents on 153 everyday tasks across 144 live production websites. It employs a specialized request-interception mechanism to safely assess actions like flight booking and shopping without completing irreversible payments.
research_notes: The benchmark is notable for operating on live, ever-changing websites rather than static snapshots, utilizing a Request Interceptor to block final submission steps.

evolution.summary: The project expanded into a broader ecosystem including ClawsBench for office productivity safety, WildClawBench for high-difficulty 'in the wild' agency, and ResearchClawBench for autonomous scientific discovery.
